principle: Every named helper suite must be captured exactly once with layer, purpose, boundary, and activation policy.

suites.purpose: Portable rules package for SessionStart, Stop Hook, continuity docs, audit, and installation guidance.
suites.boundary: Rules and templates only; no project-specific or machine-specific hardcoding.
suites.activation: install as Codex skill or call scripts directly

suites.purpose: Portable PowerShell entrypoints for doctor, audit, project install, and system skill install.
suites.boundary: No embedded project path or user path; paths are passed as parameters.

suites.purpose: Baton, drift recovery, handoff continuity, and cross-window survival.
suites.boundary: Continuity lane only; does not replace project state/log/decision files.
suites.activation: declare path in continuity-stack.config.json when present

suites.purpose: Context compression, mainline extraction, milestone summaries, and task-card structuring.
suites.boundary: Compression lane only; does not create runtime truth.
suites.activation: declare path in continuity-stack.config.json when present

suites.purpose: Searchable construction anchors for data, API, events, state, risks, and verification.
suites.boundary: Index and verification aid only; code and contracts remain source of truth.
suites.activation: declare path in continuity-stack.config.json when present

suites.source: local assistant skill or external CLI
suites.purpose: Knowledge graph, architecture relationship discovery, graph queries, and persistent project maps.
suites.boundary: Graph understanding lane; does not replace current state or decisions.
suites.activation: declare path or command in continuity-stack.config.json

suites.purpose: Static project map, wiki, blast radius, routes, schema, components, dependencies, and MCP context tools.
suites.boundary: Code insight lane only; generated maps do not replace code evidence, decisions, or validation.
suites.activation: install command only when needed and verify with codesight --version plus a project scan

suites.purpose: Token pruning and context budget control.
suites.boundary: Only one token-pruning/hook layer should actively rewrite context at a time.
suites.activation: manual command or local hook, never auto-installed by this package

suites.purpose: Repeated-read cache and token savings for stable local data.
suites.boundary: Cache lane only; stale cache must not override current file evidence.
suites.activation: declare package path or MCP config outside the portable rules package

suites.purpose: Workflow authoring, validation, export, execution, MCP editing, and visual workflow studio.
suites.boundary: Workflow assets do not replace PROJECT_STATE, ENGINEERING_LOG, DECISIONS, or runtime validation.
suites.activation: optional commands ccwf and ccwf-mcp; trial before global install

suites.purpose: CLI or text output summarization for long command outputs.
suites.boundary: Summarizer only; use source command logs when exact details matter.
suites.activation: candidate only until the intended package or source repo is confirmed

suites.purpose: Compact command/file output with token-saving references.
suites.boundary: Compression aid only; not a durable memory or decision record.
suites.activation: optional command sqz; install progressively when smoke can pass

suites.boundary: Do not enable together with another tool controlling the same token-saving/MCP hook layer.
suites.activation: record only until a one-project trial is planned

suites.purpose: Bounded task routing to local or cheaper LLMs for summaries, extraction, and classification.
suites.boundary: Routing lane only; high-risk decisions still need primary model plus verification.

suites.purpose: Screen capture, region zoom, mouse click, and T.Claw desktop control.
suites.boundary: Desktop control lane; captures, virtualenvs, and caches are generated artifacts, not truth.
